title: Filing of Financial Statements with Registrar of Companies (Form AOC-4)
substantive_text: A copy of the financial statements, including consolidated financial statement, if any, along with all the documents which are required to be attached, duly adopted at the annual general meeting of the company, shall be filed with the Registrar within thirty days of the date of annual general meeting in Form AOC-4 or Form AOC-4 XBRL. Failure to file within the prescribed period attracts additional fee of ₹100 per day under Section 403.

title: Annual Return of Company (Form MGT-7 / MGT-7A)
substantive_text: Every company shall prepare an annual return in Form MGT-7 (or MGT-7A for One Person Company and Small Company) containing particulars as they stood on the close of the financial year regarding its registered office, principal business activities, shares, debentures, indebtedness, members, debenture-holders, promoters, directors, and meetings. The return shall be filed with the Registrar within sixty days from the date on which the annual general meeting is held.

section_or_rule: Section 179(3) & Companies (Meetings of Board and its Powers) Rules, 2014
title: Powers of Board of Directors Exercisable Only at Board Meetings
substantive_text: The Board of Directors of a company shall exercise the following powers on behalf of the company only by means of resolutions passed at meetings of the Board, namely: (a) to make calls on shareholders; (b) to authorize buy-back of securities; (c) to issue securities; (d) to borrow monies; (e) to invest funds of the company; (f) to grant loans; (g) to approve financial statement and Board report; (h) to diversify the business; (i) to approve amalgamation, merger or reconstruction; and (j) to open bank accounts and authorize signatories.

title: Notice of General Meetings and Explanatory Statement
substantive_text: A general meeting of a company may be called by giving not less than clear twenty-one days' notice either in writing or through electronic mode. A general meeting may be called after giving shorter notice if consent, in writing or by electronic mode, is accorded by not less than ninety-five per cent of the members entitled to vote thereat. Under Section 102, a statement setting out all material facts concerning each item of special business to be transacted at a general meeting shall be annexed to the notice calling such meeting.

section_or_rule: Section 164(2) & Rule 14 Companies (Appointment and Qualification of Directors) Rules
title: Disqualifications for Appointment of Director (Form DIR-8)
substantive_text: No person who is or has been a director of a company which (a) has not filed financial statements or annual returns for any continuous period of three financial years; or (b) has failed to repay deposits or interest thereon, or redeem debentures, shall be eligible to be re-appointed as a director of that company or appointed in other companies for a period of five years. Every director must submit annual disclosure in Form DIR-8 confirming non-disqualification under Section 164(2).

section_or_rule: Section 403 & Companies (Registration Offices and Fees) Rules, 2014
title: Statutory Late Filing Fees for Annual ROC Returns
substantive_text: Any document, fact or information required to be submitted, filed, registered or recorded, under Section 92 (Annual Return) or Section 137 (Financial Statements) of the Companies Act, 2013, if not submitted or filed within the period provided in those sections, may be submitted or filed after such period on payment of such additional fee which shall not be less than one hundred rupees per day (₹100/day) for each day of continuing default.

title: Mandatory Filing of Income Tax Return (ITR-6 for Companies)
substantive_text: Every corporate entity in India must file its return of income in Form ITR-6 on or before 31st October of the assessment year where the accounts are required to be audited under the Income-tax Act or any other law. Where transfer pricing reporting under Section 92E applies, the due date is 30th November. Late filing attracts fees up to ₹5,000 under Section 234F and interest at 1% per month under Section 234A.

title: Audit of Accounts of Certain Persons Carrying on Business (Tax Audit Form 3CD)
substantive_text: Every person carrying on business shall get accounts audited by a practicing Chartered Accountant if total sales, turnover or gross receipts exceed one crore rupees (₹1,00,00,000) in any previous year. The threshold is increased to ten crore rupees (₹10,00,00,000) where aggregate cash receipts and cash payments do not exceed 5% of gross receipts. The tax audit report in Form 3CA/3CB and Form 3CD must be filed on or before 30th September of the assessment year.

authority: Goods and Services Tax Network (GSTN) / CBIC
statute: Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017
title: Furnishing Details of Outward Supplies (Form GSTR-1)
substantive_text: Every registered taxable person, other than an input service distributor or non-resident, shall furnish electronically details of outward supplies of goods or services during a tax period on or before the eleventh day of the month succeeding the said tax period (or 13th day of month following quarter for QRMP taxpayers) in Form GSTR-1. Inward supplier input tax credit eligibility depends on supplier GSTR-1 filing.

authority: Goods and Services Tax Network (GSTN) / CBIC
statute: Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017
title: Monthly Summary Return and Tax Payment (Form GSTR-3B)
substantive_text: Every registered person shall furnish electronically a summary return in Form GSTR-3B and discharge net tax liability (after offsetting eligible Input Tax Credit) on or before the twentieth day of the month succeeding the tax period. Late filing attracts late fees under Section 47 (₹50 per day, ₹20 per day for nil return) and interest under Section 50 at 18% per annum on net tax discharged in cash.

title: Annual Return on Foreign Liabilities and Assets (FLAIR Portal)
substantive_text: All Indian companies and Limited Liability Partnerships (LLPs) that have received Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) or made Overseas Direct Investment (ODI) in any previous financial year, including the current year, must file the Annual Return on Foreign Liabilities and Assets (FLA) electronically on the RBI FLAIR portal on or before 15th July every year. Delay in submission attracts Late Submission Fee (LSF) under Section 13(1) of FEMA.

title: Form FC-GPR Reporting of Foreign Investment on Share Allotment
substantive_text: An Indian company issuing capital instruments to a person resident outside India shall report such issue in Form FC-GPR through the Single Master Form (SMF) on the RBI FIRMS portal not later than thirty days (30 days) from the date of allotment of the capital instruments. The report must be accompanied by Foreign Inward Remittance Certificate (FIRC), KYC from Authorised Dealer Bank, and valuation certificate by Chartered Accountant or SEBI registered merchant banker.

authority: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
title: General Obligations of Data Fiduciaries and Consent Requirements
substantive_text: A Data Fiduciary shall be responsible for complying with the provisions of this Act in respect of any processing undertaken by it or on its behalf. Processing must be grounded in valid, affirmative, free, specific, informed, and unconditional consent with a clear notice under Section 6. A Data Fiduciary shall implement appropriate technical and organizational measures, ensure completeness and accuracy of data, and erase personal data as soon as the specified purpose is fulfilled.

title: Mandatory 6-Hour Cybersecurity Incident Notification to CERT-In
substantive_text: Any service provider, intermediary, data center, body corporate and government organization shall mandatorily report cyber incidents to CERT-In within 6 hours of noticing such incidents or being brought to notice about such incidents. Covered incident categories include ransomware attacks, data breaches, unauthorized access to IT systems, and denial of service attacks.

statute: Employees' Provident Funds and Miscellaneous Provisions Act, 1952
title: Mandatory Monthly Provident Fund Remittance (ECR Form)
substantive_text: Every establishment employing twenty (20) or more persons is statutorily covered under the EPF Act. Employers must deduct 12% of basic wages, dearness allowance, and retaining allowance from eligible employees (earning up to ₹15,000/month), match with 12% employer contribution (distributed to EPF and EPS), and remit the total via Electronic Challan cum Return (ECR) on or before the 15th day of each following month.

authority: Controller General of Patents, Designs and Trade Marks (IP India)
title: Statutory Grounds for Refusal and Application for Trademark Registration
substantive_text: Under Section 9, trade marks which are devoid of any distinctive character, or indicate kind, quality, or intended purpose, shall be refused registration (Absolute Grounds). Under Section 11, a trade mark shall not be registered if there exists likelihood of confusion with an earlier trade mark across identical or similar goods/services (Relative Grounds). Filing requires application in Form TM-A with verified user statement, specification of goods/services under the Nice Classification (Classes 1-45), and representation of the mark.
